epic.title: Quality and MVP release
epic.description: Testing that spans the whole app, on top of each feature's own tests: journeys, visual regression, accessibility, performance, security, correctness, and the release.

features.title: End-to-end user journeys
tasks: First visit → sign in → upload collection → see your counters and team
Build a filter → save → copy
Admin fixes a boss → users see the fix; next AI run keeps it
Portuguese user end-to-end
Signed-out browsing of every public screen

features.title: Visual regression
tasks: Screenshot tests of all 25 screens: phone + desktop, light + dark, against approved baselines
Baseline review process for intended changes

features.title: Accessibility
tasks: Automated accessibility checks (axe) on every screen in the UI pipeline
Keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels
Colour contrast in both themes

features.title: Performance
tasks: Lighthouse CI budget on key phone screens
API load test (k6): browse, counters, filters at 50 concurrent users
Cold-start check for the scale-to-zero API

features.title: Security
tasks: OWASP top 10 review; dependency and secret scanning
Authorization tests: no access to others' data; admin-only endpoints
Upload hardening tests (malformed and huge files)

features.title: Correctness of the numbers
tasks: Nightly check: our numbers vs golden files and PvPoke spot checks; alert on drift
Mutation testing of the calculation engine (Stryker.NET) to prove the tests catch bugs

features.title: MVP release
tasks: Retire the Python Keeper Filters page once the app's filters match (golden files kept)
Release checklist and owner acceptance test on prod
Backup and restore drill with Neon
